create_coefficient_mapping: create a CoefficientMapping module to map spherical harmonic coefficients between degree l and order m representations
get_coefficient_indices: get coefficient indices for a given degree l and order m using the coefficient_idx method
transform_irreps_to_grid: transform an irreps embedding tensor to a 2D grid representation using SO3_Grid to_grid method
transform_grid_to_irreps: transform a 2D grid tensor back to irreps representation using SO3_Grid from_grid method
build_so3_grid_module: build an SO3_Grid module with configurable lmax and mmax for SO(3) grid transformations
